d: Olive-brown, chin-length wavy hair is parted on the side with short bangs framing a mature, youthful face. Sharp, narrow yellow eyes pair with a slender build. The attire consists of a deep purple pencil skirt with gold buttons, a matching purple blazer, a white collared shirt, and an oversized orange coat draped over the shoulders, all complemented by a brown leather utility harness with pouches, a black peaked cap with goggles, and knee-high black leather boots. A dark blue clipboard with white cursive text is held in one hand.
